intro_html: Fatigued by our hyperactive visual culture, Craig was moved to start making laconic, zero-budget experimental films, guided by the slogan ‘the slow and the spurious, not the fast and the furious’.
seo_desc: The films of C. M. Taylor, made under the name Slow and Spurious Films – award-winning, zero-budget experimental short films.
title_tag: Slow and Spurious Films – The Short Films of C. M. Taylor
